info.title: WSO2 Identity Server - Notification Senders API Definition
info.description: This document specifies a **RESTful API** for **WSO2 Identity Server Notification Senders**

get.summary: Get a list of email senders
get.description:
This API provides the capability to retrieve the list of email senders.
Permission required:
* /permission/admin/manage/identity/configmgt/view
Scope required:
* internal_config_mgt_view

post.description:
This API provides the capability to create an email sender.\n\nIf 'name' is not defined, 'EmailPublisher' is used as the default name.
Permission required:
* /permission/admin/manage/identity/configmgt/add
Scope required:
* internal_config_mgt_add

get.summary: Retrieve an email sender by name
get.description:
This API provides the capability to retrieve an email sender by name. The URL encoded email sender name is used as sender-name.
Permission required:
* /permission/admin/manage/identity/configmgt/view
Scope required:
* internal_config_mgt_view

put.description:
This API provides the capability to update an email sender by name. The URL encoded email sender name is used as sender-name.
Permission required:
* /permission/admin/manage/identity/configmgt/update
Scope required:
* internal_config_mgt_update

delete.summary: Delete an email sender by name
delete.description:
This API provides the capability to delete an email sender by name. The URL encoded email sender name is used as sender-name.
Permission required:
* /permission/admin/manage/identity/configmgt/delete
Scope required:
* internal_config_mgt_delete

get.summary: Get a list of SMS senders
get.description:
This API provides the capability to retrieve a list of SMS notification senders.
Permission required:
* /permission/admin/manage/identity/configmgt/view
Scope required:
* internal_config_mgt_view

post.description:
This API provides the capability to create a SMS sender. If the 'name' is not not defined, 'SMSPublisher' is taken as the default name.
Permission required:
* /permission/admin/manage/identity/configmgt/add
Scope required:
* internal_config_mgt_add

get.summary: Get a SMS sender by name
get.description:
This API provides the capability to retrieve a SMS notification sender by name. The URL encoded SMS sender name is used as sender-name.
Permission required:
* /permission/admin/manage/identity/configmgt/view
Scope required:
* internal_config_mgt_view

put.description:
This API provides the capability to update a SMS Sender. The URL encoded SMS sender name is used as sender-name.
Permission required:
* /permission/admin/manage/identity/configmgt/update
Scope required:
* internal_config_mgt_update

delete.summary: Delete a SMS sender by name
delete.description:
This API provides the capability to delete a SMS sender by name. The URL encoded SMS sender name is used as sender-name.
Permission required:
* /permission/admin/manage/identity/configmgt/delete
Scope required:
* internal_config_mgt_delete

get.summary: Get a list of push notification senders
get.description:
This API provides the capability to retrieve the list of push notification senders.
Permission required:
* /permission/admin/manage/identity/configmgt/view
Scope required:
* internal_config_mgt_view

post.description:
This API provides the capability to create a push notification sender.\n\nIf the 'name' is not defined, 'PushPublisher' is taken as the default name.
Permission required:
* /permission/admin/manage/identity/configmgt/add
Scope required:
* internal_config_mgt_add

get.summary: Retrieve a push notification sender by name
get.description:
This API provides the capability to retrieve a push notification sender by name. The URL encoded push notification sender name is used as sender-name.
Permission required:
* /permission/admin/manage/identity/configmgt/view
Scope required:
* internal_config_mgt_view

parameters.name: sender-name
parameters.description: name of the push notification sender

put.description:
This API provides the capability to update a push notification sender by name. The URL encoded push notification sender name is used as sender-name.
Permission required:
* /permission/admin/manage/identity/configmgt/update
Scope required:
* internal_config_mgt_update

parameters.name: sender-name
parameters.description: name of the push notification sender

delete.summary: Delete a push notification sender by name
delete.description:
This API provides the capability to delete a push notification sender by name. The URL encoded push notification sender name is used as sender-name.
Permission required:
* /permission/admin/manage/identity/configmgt/delete
Scope required:
* internal_config_mgt_delete
